    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    int edges_total = n * (n - 1) / 2;
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp_state(n + 1, vector<vector<int>>(edges_total + 1, vector<int>(n + 1, 0)));
    dp_state[1][0][1] = 1;

    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= edges_total; ++j) {
            for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
                int val = dp_state[i][j][k];
                if (val == 0) continue;
                if (j + i <= edges_total && k + 1 <= n) {
                    dp_state[i + 1][j + i][k + 1] = (dp_state[i + 1][j + i][k + 1] + val) % m;
                }
                for (int l = 0; l < i; ++l) {
                    int new_j = j + i - 1 - l;
                    if (new_j <= edges_total) {
                        dp_state[i + 1][new_j][k] = (dp_state[i + 1][new_j][k] + val) % m;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<vector<int>>> sum_dp(n + 1, vector<vector<int>>(n + 1, vector<int>(edges_total + 1, 0)));
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int k = 0; k <= n; ++k) {
            int total = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j <= edges_total; ++j) {
                total = (total + dp_state[i][j][k]) % m;
                sum_dp[i][k][j] = total;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<vector<vector<int>>> cumulative_sum(n + 1, vector<vector<int>>(edges_total + 1, vector<int>(n + 1, 0)));
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= edges_total; ++j) {
            int total = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k <= n; ++k) {
                total = (total + sum_dp[i][k][j]) % m;
                cumulative_sum[i][j][k] = total;
            }
        }
    }

    vector<long long> res_arr(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        long long res = (long long)i * res_arr[i - 1] % m;
        for (int k = 0; k <= n; ++k) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= edges_total; ++j) {
                if (dp_state[i][j][k] == 0) continue;
                long long val = dp_state[i][j][k];
                long long diff = cumulative_sum[i][j - 1][n] - cumulative_sum[i][j - 1][k];
                res = (res + val * (diff % m + m) % m) % m;
            }

        res_arr[i] = res;
    }

    cout << res_arr[n] << "\n";
